data.content:

This will be the fourth clash between these sides and their second competitive encounter. Serbia suffered a 2-1 home defeat in the reverse fixture two months ago. data.title: Serbia vs Germany Prediction, Lineups & Team News | RotoWire
data.content:
Serbia's midfield and left side are the thinnest part of the squad. Lukic and Maksimovic are suspended after accumulating yellow cards, and both are available for the Greece game three days later. Stankovic left camp with an adductor injury and is ruled out against Germany, Aleksa Terzic (infection) is out, and Strahinja Pavlovic (kidney blow) most likely misses the game, which removes two of the Oct. 4 back five.
